## Before submitting

- [ ] I checked the latest Beatblock Online release and documentation to confirm
      the current behavior.
- [ ] I searched the open and closed issues for the same or a similar
      improvement.
- [ ] This issue improves an existing capability rather than introducing a
      separate new feature.
- [ ] This issue describes one focused improvement.
- [ ] I removed passwords, public addresses, usernames, tokens, and other
      private information from the examples.
